item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.new_testa: Where the arrows fall, grace follows.
On hit, %s%% chance to rain arrows from %s blocks above the target: %s~%s arrows, spread 0~%s°
Falling arrows ignore armor, protection, resistance and invulnerability frames
Falling arrows deal fixed damage (they take no part in Summy Reliquary's damage multipliers) and are guided by its Sacred Heart homing
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.swift_fea: "They shall mount up with wings as eagles."
With the New Testament, the arrows fall on swift wings.
Only takes effect while the New Testament is also worn:
Falling arrow damage|%s%% of the triggering arrow's final damage
Falling arrow damage uses the triggering arrow's post-bonus amount and no longer gains further bonuses; still true damage ignoring invulnerability frames
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.wing_feat: "Your arrows shall be as wings, bringing down bread from heaven."
As the New Testament heals you, light feathers gather behind your back.

While the New Testament is also worn: every heal trigger gathers a pair of light feathers (up to 4 pairs stored); the wings only appear once 3 pairs (6 feathers) are gathered, and vanish when you drop below that
Once the 4th pair is stored, shooting spends 1 pair to turn that arrow into a Sacrament Arrow
Sacrament Arrows always trigger the New Testament; %s s out of combat, then one pair fades every %s s
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.inverse_f: "He makes me lie down in green pastures, He leads me beside still waters."
Wings grown against the wind, slowing every fall.
Falling arrow damage resolves instantly (one hit per arrow; the arrows themselves are only visual)

Passive: hold sneak in midair to slow the descent by %s%% (landing damage counts only −%s%% of the fall height); press jump in midair for %s extra jump(s) (an air jump clears the accumulated fall height)
item.summy-reliquary-apocrypha.paired_wi: "Can two walk together, except they be agreed?"
Wings that beat as one reach the same mark.
Holy arrow damage|%s%% of the trigger arrow's damage
The holy arrow is fired from your eyes toward the crosshair: full-charge arrow speed, no gravity, pierces creatures endlessly, but is stopped by blocks
While worn with the New Testament: when either effect triggers, the other always follows (after %s s)
When both rolls succeed: %s extra holy arrow(s) and +1 falling arrow
Holy arrows and falling arrows are both true damage: ignores armor, protection, resistance and invulnerability frames; holy arrows cause no knockback
